en.title: Closest DashMart
en.description:
Grid characters: a space is a road, X is a wall, and D is a warehouse. You may only move up, down, left, or right; each query asks for the shortest distance to the nearest warehouse. A query on a wall cell, out of bounds, or with no reachable warehouse returns -1.

Semantics follow the original OAMaster problem. The input protocol and the limits marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and do not mean that the original problem provides these limits.
en.input: R C Q, R lines of the character grid, and Q 0-based coordinates. Site supplement: R,C≤1000, RC≤200000, Q≤200000.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
